Name: Stocked and Sorted
Author: x7eventy7
Description:
[size=4][font=Tahoma][img]https://i.imgur.com/BLupZwo.png[/img]﻿
[font=Tahoma][size=4]This mod builds off Chest Deco by creating new textures designed for combined storage systems. Instead of focusing on single resources, each chest design represents a category with multiple related items bundled together. There are four distinct styles of crates to choose from, so you can match the look of your storage setup. Each of the five supported chest types have configuration options to choose your preferred style![/size][/font]
[/font][font=Tahoma]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wbISYFz.png[/img]﻿
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [i]"SMAPI﻿", [size=4][font=Tahoma][i]"Content Patcher"[/i][/font][/size], & "Alternative Textures"[/i]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [i]"Stardew Valley/Mods"[/i]
[*]Run the game using [i]"SMAPI"[/i]
[/list][/font][/size][font=Tahoma][size=3]Install the entire folder, which contains a content patcher mod and alternative textures mod. Both are required together for this mod to work.[/size][/font][size=4][font=Tahoma]
[font=Tahoma]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qTpspUy.png[/img]﻿
[font=Tahoma][list=1]
[*]Delete the current version inside [i][font=Tahoma][font=Tahoma][i]"Stardew Valley/Mods"[/i][/font][/font][/i]
[*][font=Tahoma]Download the latest version and unzip it into [i]"Stardew Valley/Mods"[/i][/font]
[/list][/font][/font][/font][font=Tahoma]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rgYlcA5.png[/img]﻿
